206-2105-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
206-2105-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2105-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2226-2499-4443.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-4443.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Riftwing Cloudskate by paying its mana cost.
When Riftwing Cloudskate enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4694-4802-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-7306-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1263-2060-6701-8095.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-6701-8095.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2173-5220-6505-6772.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3967-3991-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2730-2921-3175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4875-5256-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5256-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

147-5117-5686.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

1563-2457-4068-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2457-4068-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

1268-3609-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
1268-3609-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
1268-3609-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Trade Caravan

736-1025-6658.notablePrerequisites:
One of Trade Caravan or Copy Enchantment has a currency counter on it.
You control a basic Island.
736-1025-6658.description:
During your upkeep, Stasis, Trade Caravan and Copy Enchantment trigger.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Resolve the Trade Caravan and Copy Enchantment triggers, putting a currency counter on each of them.
During an opponent's upkeep, activate either Trade Caravan or Copy Enchantment by removing two currency counters from it, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

1308-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4013-4659-5474.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Bristlebud Farmer.
When Bristlebud Farmer enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

686-914-1831.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
686-914-1831.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Scholar of the Lost Trove and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Scholar of the Lost Trove from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Scholar of the Lost Trove enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Scholar of the Lost Trove trigger, causing you to cast Cold Storage from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.
If opponents control seven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2367-2440-2471-3490-4720.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Servos.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2367-2440-2471-3490-4720.description:
Activate Zabaz's first ability by paying {R}, destroying another artifact creature you control.
When the creature dies, Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Servos to start the combo, this combo nets infinite mana.

562-2512-3405.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Warrior en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Warrior en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Ayli's first ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1381-1773-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Rollicker, adding {R}.
When Nyxborn Rollicker dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Nyxborn Rollicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Nyxborn Rollicker from your library.
Cast Nyxborn Rollicker by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1645-2832-4050-4365.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting Brine Comber.
Brine Comber triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

228-1722-2034-5092.notablePrerequisites: Skullclamp attached to another creature you control.
228-1722-2034-5092.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Skullclamp attached, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Skullclamp, causing you to draw two cards.
Nadir Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to put two +1/+1 counters on Nadir Kraken and create two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Skullclamp by paying {1}, equipping it to a Tentacle token.
Repeat.

618-908-4523.description:
Pay {U} to Fylamarid to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

4832-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ensoul Artifact is attached to Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4832-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4832-5107-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat
